methods.label: Combine equal tangent segments
methods.explanation: Let the points of tangency lie on \(AB\), \(BC\), and \(CA\), respectively. By equality of tangent lengths, \(BE=(AB+BC-CA)/2=(7+8-9)/2=3\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 9 tangent length theorem and elementary addition and subtraction of segment lengths.
